description: Run a Hermes Agent job as a managed external operation. Call op:start with task, then let the operation driver poll with op:poll and op_id. The adapter uses HERMES_API_URL and the API_SERVER_KEY bearer credential from its environment; never put secrets in action args.

op.description: Start a Hermes run or poll an existing managed-operation handle.

op_id.description: Opaque managed-operation handle. Required with op:poll.
